services.name: Cleanse Affliction
services.hook: The realm's priests lay hands on the sick and the cursed.
services.task: {target}: counteract {note} as a rank {rank} spell with +{mod}.

services.name: Restoration
services.hook: Long rites in the temple put back what a curse or a wound took.
services.chat: {target} spends a day in the temple of {settlement}.

services.name: Regeneration
services.hook: A cathedral's choir sings a lost limb back.
services.chat: The choir of {settlement} sings for {target} through the night.

services.name: Raise the Fallen
services.hook: The whole realm holds vigil while the high priests call a hero back.
services.notePrompt: How did they fall? (for the chat)
services.chat: Bells ring across the realm. In the cathedral of {settlement}, the high priests hold vigil over {target}, and the people pray with them.
services.task: {target}: Raise Dead at rank {rank}, as the spell; the realm has paid. The usual drawbacks apply.

services.name: Royal Teleport
services.hook: The academy's mages send the party across the realm in a heartbeat.
services.chat: The mages of {settlement} open the way: the party steps out in {to}.

services.name: Royal Archives
services.hook: Scholars comb the realm's library for everything known about one thing.
services.chat: The scholars of {settlement} set to work on {note}.
services.task: For the next 30 days the party gets +2 circumstance to research and Recall Knowledge about {note}. Share anything the archives would turn up.

services.name: Patrol the Roads
services.hook: The watch rides out ahead of the party.
services.chat: Patrols from {settlement} ride the realm's roads ahead of the party.
services.task: For the next 7 days, no random encounters while the party travels through claimed hexes.

services.name: Royal Feast
services.hook: A feast in someone's honour, with the whole court watching.
services.chat: The court of {settlement} feasts in {target}'s honour.
